title: Platform-ecosystem decision index
description: The build-phase handoff index: one row per decision the downstream document must make. Machine-readable, capability-tagged, evidence-linked and ordered, so a build phase reads this file rather than re-deriving the survey.

as_of.description: The report date. The staleness marker on a contractual cell is measured against it.

convergent_answer.description: NULL where the convergence lens finds none -- which is a real result, not a gap. A divergence is never resolved by dropping the weaker source.

dissent_basis.description: Why the dissenting set dissents, named. Required whenever anything dissents: a dissent with no basis is a divergence resolved by ignoring it.

build_first.description: `true`, `false`, or `defer-until:<trigger>`. The TRIGGER's presence is refused by a RULE rather than by this pattern, because the reason -- a deferral says what un-defers it, and a bare `later` is exactly what this field replaces -- is what the author needs to read.

capability_tags.description: Validated against the project's capability map by the synthesis run's OWN first deterministic check; the portable gate never sees that file.

evidence.description: Extract record ids. Every lens output must be copied from a record that says it.

stale.description: Set where this row rests on a contractual record older than the staleness window. A stale contractual term read as current is how a fabricated industry standard enters a document.

not_applicable.description: Report sections whose angle the TRIGGER excluded -- never dispatched, as distinct from vacated or ran-and-found-nothing. The section renders this predicate rather than an empty heading, because silence reads as `we looked and found nothing`.

absence.description: The mandatory coverage receipt. An angle that VACATED for want of a source produced no evidence about the world; one that RAN and found nothing did.

claim.description: Phrased as what was not found across what was searched, at the corpus revisions searched -- never as what no platform does.
